Every purchase increments ticketCount by one and totalEntries by at least one; neither lifetime counter decreases after burns, so ticketCount <= totalEntries.
For integer n, floor((n*1,000,000)*500/10,000)=n*50,000; no residue accumulates across purchases.
For every positive n, the cash payout is n*800,000 >= 800,000, so NoWinnerProceeds does not reject an unredeemed cash allocation.
Maximum protocol and cash numerators use 157 and 161 bits respectively; the uint256 fast path in mulDiv returns the exact integer split.
Stored minted ranges are positive and disjoint; the sum of lengths of any distinct live-ticket subset is at most totalEntries.
Empty and >100 batches revert; ownerOf rejects unknown IDs; a duplicate ID fails ownerOf after the first burn and reverts the full transaction.
requestDraw requires totalEntries>0 and the callback computes randomWords[0]%totalEntries+1; therefore default range [0,0] cannot pass in a resolved state.
1 <= word%totalEntries+1 <= totalEntries <= 2^128-1; the uint128 cast cannot lose bits.
Refunds require Refunding; winner burns follow settlement in NftWon or CashWon; resolved branches never return to sales or refunds.
